question: A logistics coordinator depends on a carrier rate sheet that the finance team edits every week. Which maintenance approach is better?
options: A) Upload one copy of the rate sheet, since an uploaded copy follows the original whenever it changes.
B) Keep the rate sheet reachable through the connected drive so Claude works from the current version.
C) Ask Claude to remember the rates in one chat and to reuse those figures in all later chats.
D) Paste the rate figures into the project instructions, where they are least likely to be edited by others.
correct_answers: B) Keep the rate sheet reachable through the connected drive so Claude works from the current version.
explanations: An uploaded document is a snapshot; it does not update when the original is edited.
Correct. A connected source reflects the file as it stands, which removes a weekly manual refresh.
Detail mentioned in one conversation is not carried into other chats as project context.
Figures that change weekly are the worst possible content for durable instructions.
